text: 🍿 'Digger' is messy, and Cruise is why it works 📆 Release: October 2, 2026 🎭 Genre: #Comedy · #Satire ✈️ Add to watchlist Alejandro G. Iñárritu returns to English-language filmmaking for the first time since 'The Revenant' , with a "comedy of catastrophic proportions." SlashFilm's early review says his indulgences nearly sink it. That tracks. The 'Birdman' ego-trip energy is right there in the pitch. 🎬 What intrigues me is Tom Cruise as the lifeline. Since 'Tropic Thunder' we know he's game for gleeful self-parody, and an auteur with a big satirical swing needs exactly that anchor. I'm in, with one eyebrow raised.

🍿 Reacher already has a Season 6, and Season 5 isn't even finished Prime Video renewed the show while cameras are still rolling in Toronto on the "Make Me" season. That's not a streamer hedging its bets. I like it. 💪 Alan Ritchson turned a guy who punches people into a reliable global draw, and Season 4 reportedly pulled 66 million viewers in 28 days. That puts Reacher next to 'Bosch' as Prime's longest-running scripted staple. My only worry is formula fatigue, but the one-book-per-season setup keeps it honest. ✈️ Add to watchlist

🎬 Assayas and Stewart are back. "Spiritual World" looks like the film they were always going to make again. Olivier Assayas described the project as being "in the vein" of Personal Shopper , which tells you everything. Kristen Stewart alongside Vicky Krieps, Riley Keough, Wagner Moura , and Barbara Sukowa. That's a serious ensemble. The Fassbinder regular Sukowa in an Assayas ghost story signals something more European, more patient. Krieps fresh off Corsage adds another layer. This won't be mainstream comfort food, and that's exactly the point.

It earns the hype. 📆 Release: December 25, 2026 🎭 Genre: #Horror ✈️ Add to watchlist Robert Eggers and the werewolf myth feel like a natural fit, and the trailer proves it. SlashFilm calls it the perfect companion piece. I buy that.
